channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: Amazon closed out hyperscaler earnings week with the same message as Google and Microsoft: demand is ahead of supply. AWS revenue rose 39.3% to $46.0 billion, its fastest growth in nearly five years, its backlog reached $578 billion, more than double a year earlier, and Andy Jassy said AWS is installing an AI accelerator about every 14 seconds with customers taking it almost as fast. Cash capex was $75.9 billion in the quarter; Amazon kept 2026 at about $220 billion and said 2027 will be meaningfully more. Upstream, the squeeze is in packaging: Intel said substrate supply limits how fast it can scale EMIB, and Taiwan press reports TSMC is weighing CoWoS price rises of 10% to 20%. Ottawa turned sovereign AI into a compute obligation, with up to C$1.6 billion of equity in Cohere tied to at least C$1.7 billion of new Canadian computing infrastructure by 2030. On the public tape all 70 list prints confirmed; Lambda H100 holds at $3.99 and B200 at $6.69 per GPU-hour.

item.title: Compute brief - 30 October 2026
item.description: Amazon closed out hyperscaler earnings week with the same message as Google and Microsoft: demand is ahead of supply. AWS revenue rose 39.3% to $46.0 billion, its fastest growth in nearly five years, its backlog reached $578 billion, more than double a year earlier, and Andy Jassy said AWS is installing an AI accelerator about every 14 seconds with customers taking it almost as fast. Cash capex was $75.9 billion in the quarter; Amazon kept 2026 at about $220 billion and said 2027 will be meaningfully more. Upstream, the squeeze is in packaging: Intel said substrate supply limits how fast it can scale EMIB, and Taiwan press reports TSMC is weighing CoWoS price rises of 10% to 20%. Ottawa turned sovereign AI into a compute obligation, with up to C$1.6 billion of equity in Cohere tied to at least C$1.7 billion of new Canadian computing infrastructure by 2030. On the public tape all 70 list prints confirmed; Lambda H100 holds at $3.99 and B200 at $6.69 per GPU-hour. Countries: Canada: Up to C$1.6 billion of federal equity in Cohere; Cohere commits at least C$1.7 billion to computing infrastructure in Canada by 2030 (Wire, 29 Oct). China: Envision targets end-2028 for its Ulanqab Galaxy campus, eventually up to 3 GW, with offtake through 2029 or 2030 (Wire, 30 Oct, single source). India: AM Intelligence reportedly seeks up to $3 billion of debt to buy Nvidia Rubin GPUs for India and Malaysia (Wire, 30 Oct, single source). United Kingdom: Data Centre Covenant: 6 GW of AI data centre capacity needed by 2030; grid capacity reserved for strategic sites (Wire, 28 Oct).
